searchText: Is xatu not expected to work with fulu yet? I see that it uses https://github.com/attestantio/go-eth2-client which follows the beacon API. Since fulu changes aren't made yet, xatu won't work properly, right? <@84562395988508672> ^ I was working on this over the weekend: https://github.com/testinprod-io/Peeroor and got it to roughly work. But I figured we could just easily set the nodes as staticpeers in CLI command...(one benefit would be peering without restarting the nodes) Would love to know if you think this would be worth finalizing for actual usage? This is awesome! 😄 did you already try this on all RPCs btw? Like the execution client types? Yup Not yet, I've just tested it with geth. But think I'll get to use it this week for other devnets 😆 sounds great! we'd also likely use it if its working well 😄 Give me a week and I'll test it and add some finishing touches! 🙂
